items.headline: RUM Group Shares Surge Wednesday: What's Driving the Action?
items.summary: RUM Group shares are trading higher Wednesday as investors react to record revenue, closes and a newly expanded AI-infrastructure narrative.

items.headline: Accelerant Holdings, CorMedix, Birkenstock And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Thursday
items.summary: Nasdaq Composite gained 200 points on Thursday, while Accelerant Holdings (NYSE: ARX) rose 44.2% after being acquired by Thoma Bravo and reporting strong Q2 results. Other top gainers include Omeros Corp (NASDAQ: OMER), CorMedix Inc (NASDAQ: CRMD), and Hyliion Holdings Corp (NYSE: HYLN).
